original_test_intent: Verify a 60-second GPUDirect Storage read and compare it fairly with an approved non-GDS control on the same storage/GPU path.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Run gdsio against the source path with GPU index 4, 1 GiB total, 1 MiB I/O, one worker, read, xfer type 0 and 60 seconds.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Compare GDS and non-GDS performance; source paths are malformed/inconsistent and no control command is defined.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION and retained path/control-method SOURCE_CONFLICT plus storage safety gates.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer supplies a safe mounted file, GPU mapping and official paired transfer modes; benchmark execution is automated.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 60-second GDS read with the stated 1 GiB/1 MiB/one-worker/GPU-index-4/xfer-type-0 parameters and a non-GDS comparison.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: Safe path, GPU UUID mapping, supported GDS stack, documented control mode and fair cache/order/repetition policy.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Changed file, GPU, transfer mode, workload or repetition policy must be shown.

original_method: All original gdsio parameters and malformed path text are preserved as provenance.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the NVIDIA GDS gdsio version supported by the installed CUDA/GDS stack, with UUID-confirmed GPU and a regular file on a validated mounted filesystem; select a documented non-GDS transfer mode for the control.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: Officially supported GPU, driver, CUDA/GDS, filesystem and storage topology.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Must match the installed GDS release matrix.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: NVIDIA GPUDirect Storage documentation and gdsio help for the installed version.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects target identity and adds a documented paired control without changing the GDS read intent.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The control must match size, I/O size, worker count, duration and path.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Stack versions, topology, safe file, xfer-mode definitions and comparison tolerance.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Raw/ambiguous path use can damage data; cache/topology differences can invalidate comparison.

missing_inputs: Documented non-GDS xfer type and comparison policy
safety_boundaries: No raw or malformed device path
No `dd` or guessed CPU transfer mode
No unapproved cache manipulation or universal performance claim
expected_evidence: Stack versions and exact paired commands
Results/errors, comparison calculation and platform health
no_automatic_retry: Benchmark failures are retained; repetitions must be pre-approved, not reactive retries.
engineer_owned_verdict: Storage/GPU engineer judges comparability and result.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already preserved the exact workload while preventing a malformed path and invented control mode from becoming an executable command.
